detail.longDescription: Hello, this is Cahut. # introduction Cahut is a home for everything your AIs make: documents, decks, dashboards and small apps, as living pages on your own server. One command installs it on a Linux server. Your AI publishes over MCP. You share a link, not a file. Before anything that cannot be undone, the AI knocks first and a person approves. Early development. The first version works. https:// cahut.cloud # SelfHosted # OpenSource # MCP # FOSS
